output.summary: KEP-2531 proposes a Cloud Provider for BaiduCloud under sig-cloud-provider, integrating Kubernetes with Baidu's container and cloud services (CCE, BPC, CNAP, BEC) and maintaining cloud resource interfaces (node, routing, load balancing). Its current status is implementable, stage alpha.
output.rationale: The KEP aims to integrate and extend Kubernetes with Baidu Cloud services and to build and maintain cloud resource interfaces for full lifecycle management, plus vendor-neutral testing tools. The excerpt limits its scope: no standard technical support for a specific vendor, and no work on features unrelated to Kubernetes integration. The provided excerpt does not explain the reasoning behind the implementable/alpha status beyond these goals.

evidence.quote: Developing and maintaining cloud resource (node, routing, load balancing, etc.) interface and configurations for full lifecycle management with Kubernetes.
The subproject will not provide any standard technical support for specific cloud vendor.
Integrating and extending Kubernetes with Baidu Cloud Container Engine(CCE), Baidu Private Cloud(BPC)
